queries.name: functions.numeric
queries.sql:
SELECT
      abs(-3) AS a1,
      abs(-3.5) AS a2,
      abs('-4x') AS a3,
      abs(NULL) AS a4,
      round(2.5) AS a5,
      round(-2.5) AS a6,
      round(123.456, 2) AS a7,
      round(123.456, -1) AS a8,
      round(1, 2) AS a9,
      round(NULL, 2) AS a10,
      min(3, 1, 2) AS a11,
      max(3, 1, 2) AS a12,
      min('2', 10) AS a13,
      max('2', 10) AS a14,
      min(1, 1.0) AS a15,
      max(1, 1.0) AS a16,
      min(NULL, 1) AS a17,
      max('a', 'B', 'b') AS a18

queries.name: functions.text
queries.sql:
SELECT
      length('abc') AS b1,
      length('') AS b2,
      length(12345) AS b3,
      length(1.0) AS b4,
      length(x'000102') AS b5,
      lower('AbC') AS b6,
      lower('ÄÖÜ') AS b7,
      lower(123) AS b8,
      upper('Abc') AS b9,
      upper('äöü') AS b10,
      substr('abcdef', 2) AS b11,
      substr('abcdef', 2, 3) AS b12,
      substr('abcdef', -2) AS b13,
      substr('abcdef', -2, 1) AS b14,
      substr('abcdef', 2, -1) AS b15,
      substr('abcdef', 0, 2) AS b16,
      substr('abcdef', 1, 0) AS b17,
      substr('abcdef', 1, 100) AS b18,
      substr('abcdef', 10, 2) AS b19,
      substr(NULL, 1) AS b20,
      substr(12345, 2, 2) AS b21

queries.name: functions.conditional
queries.sql:
SELECT
      coalesce(NULL, NULL, 3) AS c1,
      coalesce(NULL, 'x') AS c2,
      ifnull(NULL, 2) AS c3,
      ifnull(1, 2) AS c4,
      nullif(1, 1) AS c5,
      nullif(1, 2) AS c6,
      nullif(NULL, NULL) AS c7,
      iif(1, 'yes', 'no') AS c8,
      iif(0, 'yes', 'no') AS c9,
      iif(NULL, 'yes', 'no') AS c10,
      iif('x', 1, 2) AS c11,
      typeof(NULL) AS c12,
      typeof(1) AS c13,
      typeof(1.5) AS c14,
      typeof('x') AS c15,
      typeof(x'00') AS c16,
      typeof(abs('3')) AS c17,
      typeof(random()) AS c18

queries.name: functions.trim_replace
queries.sql:
SELECT
      trim('  abc  ') AS d1,
      trim('xxabcxx', 'x') AS d2,
      ltrim('xxabc', 'x') AS d3,
      rtrim('abcxx', 'x') AS d4,
      trim('abc', '') AS d5,
      trim(NULL, 'x') AS d6,
      trim(123, '2') AS d7,
      replace('abcabc', 'ab', 'X') AS d8,
      replace('abc', '', 'X') AS d9,
      replace(NULL, 'a', 'b') AS d10,
      replace('abc', NULL, 'b') AS d11,
      replace('abc', 'b', NULL) AS d12

queries.name: functions.instr_hex_quote

SELECT
      instr('abcdef', 'cd') AS e1,
      instr('abcdef', 'zz') AS e2,
      instr('abc', '') AS e3,
      instr('', '') AS e4,
      instr(NULL, 'a') AS e5,
      instr('abc', NULL) AS e6,
      instr(12345, 34) AS e7,
      hex('abc') AS e8,
      hex(x'0001AB') AS e9,
      hex(123) AS e10,
      hex(1.5) AS e11,
      hex(NULL) AS e12,
      quote(NULL) AS e13,
      quote(123) AS e14,
      quote(1.5) AS e15,
      quote('abc') AS e16,
      quote(x'00AB') AS e17,
      quote('a''b') AS e18
